reason: MeowDB gives every Maple Island NPC a speech-bubble pool (canonical idle_chatter in game/data/canonical/npcs/<id>.json, 2 to 10 lines; docs/canonical/npcs.md 'Speech bubbles') but no interval, display time or order. MisoStory shows the canonical lines now and then above NPCs of the current map that are on screen and not in a conversation; the timing below is MisoStory's presentation choice, read by NpcBubbleSchedule. The text is always a canonical line.

reasons.first_delay_min_s: The first bubble of each NPC comes 2-10 s after the map is shown (a per-NPC seeded delay), so a town does not speak all at once.
reasons.interval_min_s: 14-26 s between an NPC's bubbles keeps a town lively without covering the screen; classic NPC balloons appear every several seconds, but the interval is not documented.
reasons.display_s: Long enough to read the longest Maple Island bubble line at a relaxed pace.
reasons.order: 'sequential': the lines in canonical order from a per-NPC seeded starting line, so every line is seen; 'random' draws each line (seeded).
